purpose: Teach: 國/瓦/梁/メス/霊的/孤児/村人/住職

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、外、絶対、國、絶対、市場、絶対、開拓しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need our company to develop foreign markets seriously and absolutely. Count on it.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding opening. Clipped delivery, each phrase lands with weight. Steady eye contact. No room for negotiation. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本社、本気で、絶対、瓦、絶対、屋根、絶対、修繕、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're moving forward earnestly on our expansion efforts. Thank you for the clear direction.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Slightly formal register. Even pacing. Acknowledges the instruction without overexplaining. Professional deference without obsequiousness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 倉庫、本気で、絶対、梁、絶対、補強、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The warehouse structural reinforcement needs to happen. Make it happen. I'm serious.
lines.style: Direct and firm. Slight pause before the final command. Lower register. The sound of someone who doesn't repeat themselves often, so when they do, it carries weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。医療向け、本気で、絶対、メス、絶対、の販売、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're currently reviewing options for medical-grade equipment sales. We appreciate the priority.
lines.style: Calm, steady response. Professional cadence. Slight formality in word choice to show respect for the instruction. Confident without presumption.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、霊的、絶対、な、絶対、商品、絶対、扱うな、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Do not stock spiritual or occult products. That's non-negotiable. I'm clear on this.
lines.style: Stern, almost grave. Slower tempo on the opening clause. A hard stop on 'non-negotiable.' This is a boundary, not a suggestion. The weight of principle behind it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、孤児、絶対、支援、絶対、CSR、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're actively advancing our orphan support CSR initiative. Thank you for the mandate.
lines.style: Alert, affirming tone. Crisp pacing. Shows the instruction has been received and is already in motion. Respectful without sounding rehearsed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、村人、絶対、向け、絶対、商品、絶対、企画しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Design products with the local community in mind. Make it happen. This matters.
lines.style: Deliberate and purposeful. Slight warmth beneath the authority—this instruction reflects values, not just profit. Lean forward slightly. Clear and unrushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地元、本気で、絶対、住職、絶対、ご相談、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Absolutely. We're consulting with local religious leaders to guide the approach. We're grateful for this direction.
lines.style: Warm, affirming conclusion. Slightly softer than before—shows respect for the community-centered nature of the instruction. Measured, thoughtful pacing. A sense of shared purpose.
